Hi Yang,

Glad that's working for you now.

I don't know the hBayesDM package, but we definitely recommend running more than three chains. I see you have chains=3 but 5000 iterations per chain. Typically you'll want at least 4 chains but need fewer iterations (our somewhat conservative default -- for NUTS sampler only -- is 1000 warmup + 1000 sampling per chain). For some models you'll need to increase the number of iterations, but rarely if ever do you want to be decreasing the number of chains. The more chains you run the better chance you have of discovering pathological regions of the posterior that shouldn't be ignored.

Jonah
